messages:
alex: FYI — scheduling a pre-apply for infra changes for release v1.8.0 tonight 02:00 UTC. Need final pin list, release notes sync, and an escape-hatch plan. Plan affects: networking/vpc, iam/roles, terraform modules: `edge-gw`, `shared-iam`, `tfstate-backend`.

maya: Can you paste the exact `terraform apply` invocation? Also do we have a deploy-bot window? @deploy-bot ?

deploy-bot: Schedule created by alex at 2198765432. Queue position: 3. Apply window: 2026-03-20T02:00Z. Trigger: manual. Preflight: `tf plan -var-file=prod.tfvars` required.

simon: Strongly suggest provider pinning to `hashicorp/aws 4.61.0` and `terraform 1.6.0` in the root. We saw drift when the provider auto-upgraded last month.

alex: Agreed. I'll add a `versions.tf` snapshot and include migration notes in release doc. Snippet:
```
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.6.0, < 1.7.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 4.61.0" }
  }
}
```

ops_lead: Escape hatch checklist — short:
- Abort deploy by commenting `#hold` on the scheduled run or run `deploy-bot cancel <job-id>`
- If apply starts, immediate rollback via `terraform state replace-provider` is risky; prefer targeted reapply of previous module commit tag.
- Open postmortem ticket if any IAM changes touched cross-account trusts.

jules: Release notes: add explicit "DB subnet changes may require 5min restart" and include monitoring playbook link https://internal/docs/runbooks/infra-apply-checks. I'll draft it.

maya: Also add canary: run apply in one AZ/one VPC first (use `module.edge-gw[0]` targeting) then wait 30m with SLO dashboard green.

alex: Plan: 1) push `versions.tf` and release notes now; 2) preflight: run `tf plan` in staging and attach output; 3) apply canary to us-east-1a; 4) monitor 30m; 5) if green, continue serial apply across AZs; 6) if failure, run `rollback: revert infra-main@<previous-commit>` and notify.

simon: +1. Who is on-call for apply window? @jules @ops_lead

jules: I'm on-call. Will be watching logs and SLO dashboard.

deploy-bot: Preflight passed for job 9876, plan size: 42 changes (7 destructive). Artifacts: s3://prod-tfplans/9876.plan

alex: OK locking change window to 02:00-03:30 UTC. Put a soft hold if any unresolved CRs. I'll update the release ticket with the job id and plan link.

maya: Thx. Adding a note to release notes: `BREAKING: iam: default role assume_policy tightened; check cross-account services`

deploy-bot: Apply started for job 9876 by alex at 2198765800.

ops_lead: Monitoring: watching `infra-apply` trace, costs, and SLOs. If latency >2x baseline or 5% errors, abort.

deploy-bot: Apply failed: module.shared-iam.aws_iam_role.service_role: error creating IAM Role: EntityAlreadyExists: Role with name "svc-edge" already exists

alex: hitting the existing-role race. Rolling forward plan: 1) pause further AZ applies; 2) try targeted import: `terraform import module.shared-iam.aws_iam_role.service_role svc-edge`; 3) re-run plan; if import not safe, revert to previous commit and open rollback.

simon: I'll attempt import. Pushing my session link: ssh://jump/team@simon-session

jules: If import succeeds, we need to run a focused smoke test (auth flows) before continuing.

alex: Update: import succeeded. Re-running plan now. If green, we'll restart canary apply in us-east-1a. Will post final status.

deploy-bot: Apply succeeded for job 9876 at 2198766020. Changes applied: 42, destructive: 0 (race resolved via import).

maya: Nice. Please follow up on release notes with exact mitigation steps and mark deployment done.

alex: Done — updated release ticket and added post-apply checklist. Thanks everyone :tada:
